entries.name: Floor Back Extension
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft with a spine that arches. Lying face down with the arms reaching ahead; the pelvis stays on the floor while the spine arches a little so the chest and arms come a few inches up, and the long legs lift a few inches from the hips, a short hold, and a slower lowering. The lift is kept small on purpose: the source says height is not the goal, and the trunk bends through its length; it is not launched up as one stiff piece.
entries.summary: Face down with the arms reaching ahead, lift the chest, arms and legs a few inches off the floor, hold a beat, then lower with control.

frames.caption: Lie face-down with your arms reaching ahead.
Lift your chest, arms, and legs a few inches off the floor by squeezing the glutes and upper back.
Hold a beat. Reach long through fingers and toes.
Reach long, then lift: length before height.
